svg.title: Mitigation register worksheet
svg.desc: Spreadsheet view of Mitigation register, generated from safety/hazards/*.yaml (mitigations).
svg.text: Hardware interlock removes propulsion power while the retention
PX4 arming check requires dock-released state
Rotor guards on the dock enclosure
Maintenance procedure with propeller removal for powered checks
Fail-closed mechanical latch requiring powered actuation to open
Independent dual sensing of latch position fused into the retained
Walker motion inhibited while retention state is unknown
Charger with independent over-voltage, over-current and
Dock separated from the pod by a fire barrier, with venting away
Do not charge a battery after a hard landing until inspected
Launch and release permits require charging de-energised and
Connector rated to break under load, or mechanically prevented
Contacts shrouded and de-energised unless a UAV is seated and
Charging isolated before any handling at the dock (maintenance
Locate the dock away from the pilot station so approach paths
Envelope inhibit on posture, motion and dock-ready state
Independent hardware launch permit between integration manager
Verified PX4 lost-link abort behaviour for recovery (SITL)
On link loss the aircraft holds briefly, then lands in place (PX4
NAV_DLL_ACT = 3, Land) and never returns to the dock without a
permit (decision DQ-008, lead, 2026-11-12; SITL SU-03 stayed 48
m clear, synthetic). The low-battery failsafe still needs a decision.
The integration manager keeps PX4 home and rally points at the
current dock position as the walker moves
Validity checks on IF-PX4-001 (estimator status, position
accuracy, freshness) before any permit is granted
UAV data shown with validity status; position and imagery checked
against an independent source before use
Stale or frozen imagery detected within a defined time and shown
Procedure: UAV imagery is advisory; walking decisions rest on
direct view and the safety observer
Arms stowed and locked before walking is enabled, and held
stowed until walking stops (CL-05 stowed pose lifts the claws to
2.43 m and pulls them back from 1.77 m to 1.49 m ahead of the
Manipulation inhibited unless the exclusion zone around the arms'
Exclusion zone procedure with a safety observer holding an
Loaded walking only with the load confirmed secured, the arms
locked in a defined carry pose and mass and centre of gravity
within limits; reduced speed, step height and slope
Carry pose keeps the load low and close to the body and below the
pilot's sight line (CL-05: load centre 1.80 m up, 0.10 m ahead of
the pod; nearest ground seen ahead unchanged at 3.98 m)
Exclusion zone sized for a loaded walker
Mechanical supports carry the chassis in OFF/SECURED and
STARTUP so actuator motion cannot lower the structure
Readiness interlock: actuation enabled only with restraint, hatch,
Independent hardware enable chain in series with the software
Ingress procedure with observer and exclusion zone
Ingress and egress from a controlled lowered (kneel) posture with
a fold-down ladder and grab handles, the ladder interlocked against
walking (CL-05: cockpit floor from 2.41 m to about 1.0 m, four
Select self-locking (non-backdrivable) joint actuation in the
actuation trade, so loss of supply cannot lower the structure
valves or brakes), so loss of supply engages it without any signal
Load-holding engagement time verified shorter than the free-fall
time from the highest operating posture
Energy-absorbing seat and cockpit suspension sized for the
Shoulder plate under each hatch is a step flush with the sill with
non-slip strips, a toe lip and grab rails (CL-05)
Fold-out davit and escape ladder clear of the walker (CL-05: 0.25
Fall-arrest harness and anchor point, and egress training
Emergency exit through a side hatch that needs neither platform
power nor the kneel posture (CL-05 side hatches)
Lowered posture with defined lowering limits and a confirmed clear
Egress procedure and training for the case where the walker
Evaluate electromechanical actuation (trade study) to eliminate
Lockable isolation and automatic accumulator bleed with pressure
Mechanical supports required before maintenance access
Lockout/tagout and zero-energy verification procedure; PPE
Select a cell chemistry with low thermal-runaway energy (trade
Locate the pack outside the cockpit behind a fire barrier, with vent
Independent battery monitoring that opens the pack contactors on
over-temperature, over-voltage or over-current, with a cockpit
Post-fall pack inspection, charging procedure and pilot
Separate the fuel system and exhaust from the cockpit and from
each other, with drip and heat shields
Fuel shut-off and engine stop commanded by the protective stop
Refuelling only in MOD-01 with the engine cold, extinguisher at
Load-holding valves / brakes hold posture on loss of power
Mode-specific protective stop behaviour that never commands
instant zero torque in a loaded pose
Mechanical joint end-stops and pressure relief limit runaway travel
Feedback staleness and plausibility monitor commanding the
Low centre of gravity and wide stance selected in the architecture
Rollover/fall protective structure and restraint at the pilot station
Command and payload limiting to a verified stability envelope
Stability margin warning to the pilot
Start the protective crouch and engage load holding on falling
balance margin (capture point against the support still available),
not only on a supply-pressure threshold, and only in a statically
Size ankle and knee torque so that the balance capacity left as
supply falls holds the walker until load holding engages, anywhere
Loaded walking only within mass, centre-of-gravity, speed,
step-height and slope limits, with the load secured and the arms
Kneel and rise only while the area under and around the pod and
legs is confirmed clear, at a controlled speed
Load holding keeps the posture on loss of actuator supply during
Marked crush zone and observer during kneel and rise

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · CONOPS = concept of operations ·

DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3

= review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record

(M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · MOD-nnn = operating mode from the CONOPS (MOD-01 to MOD-10) · PPE = personal

protective equipment · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) ·

SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · SZ-nnn = actuator sizing study at
level 2 (sim/mujoco/sizing.yaml) · TS-nnn = architecture trade study · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
